title: WF03 OBS-04 integration compile blockers: missing bpm.instance_routes export and optional-string return mismatch
summary: OBS-04 integration could not compile because tests/integration/obs04_timeline_test.zig imported bpm.instance_routes but src/bpm.zig did not re-export instance_routes. After export wiring, a second compile error surfaced in extractJsonStringField return typing (!?[]u8 vs ![]u8). Both defects were fixed and OBS-04 integration tests ran successfully via a dedicated requirement-scoped build step.

root_cause.details: The integration shim module src/bpm.zig lacked instance_routes export expected by OBS-04 tests, and the helper extractJsonStringField returned allocator.dupe directly instead of a coerced optional payload, violating Zig 0.16 return typing.

changes: Added pub const instance_routes = @import("api/routes/instances.zig") in src/bpm.zig.
Updated tests/integration/obs04_timeline_test.zig extractJsonStringField to return try allocator.dupe(...) for !?[]u8 compatibility.
Added build.zig step test-integration-obs04 for deterministic OBS-04 requirement-scoped integration validation.

prevention: When adding integration tests that import bpm, verify src/bpm.zig re-exports every referenced route/store module.
For Zig optional-return helpers, return payload values via try/cast rather than returning a non-optional error union directly.
Prefer dedicated requirement-scoped integration build steps over forwarded --test-filter arguments in Zig 0.16 runs.
